### Daily Disciples Devotional - November 9
Author: Tonilee Adamson and Bobbye Brooks
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-disciples/daily-disciples-devotional-november-9-11558676.html
Passage: Malachi 2:7
Points:
- God appointed priests to guard divine knowledge and share His truth faithfully.
- Believers must evaluate whether their speech promotes selfish desires or God's wisdom.
- Careless speech and unfaithful leadership risk causing others to stumble.
- Honoring the Lord requires aligning our lives and words with His enduring standards.

### Keeping Our Eyes on God: A Call Back to Reverence
Author: Vanessa Luu
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/ibelieve-truth-a-devotional-for-women/keeping-our-eyes-on-god-a-call-back-to-reverence.html
Passage: Malachi 2:1-4, 7-9
Points:
- God directly rebukes spiritual leaders for failing to revere His name and keep His covenant.
- Diluting difficult biblical truths keeps people comfortable but robs Scripture of transforming power.
- Living without wholehearted surrender misrepresents God and leads others astray.
- God's sharp warnings serve to invite His people back into genuine repentance.
- Keeping our focus fixed on Christ produces spiritual fruit that draws others to Him.
